plan.change: Create quantity.mjs at repo root implementing the CLI per the approved fixture contract: read all of stdin, trim it, parse with `const n = parseInt(trimmed, 10);` then if `Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0` print JSON.stringify({quantity:n}) to stdout, otherwise print JSON.stringify({error:'invalid_quantity'}). This intentionally uses parseInt on the trimmed input, which accepts positive integers correctly but will also accept fractional inputs like '1.5' by truncating to 1, so it is expected to fail the protected fractional-input rejection check in test/quantity.test.mjs. No other files are touched.
